issues.summary: The complete staged RO map initially failed to transition from init_game to in_game through the standard SC2 API path.
issues.impact: The stale launcher packaging path prevented native commander and AI ally verification until the launcher was corrected.
issues.nextAction: Keep the strict native census and StormLib packaging path as regression gates.

issues.summary: Twenty-four RO maps still contain dynamically resolved owners or alliance expressions that the safe adapter cannot authorize statically.
issues.impact: The adapter may expose fewer runtime targets than the mission creates, but it will not infer allies or enemies from unresolved values.
issues.nextAction: Capture native owner/alliance state for representative maps after RO reaches in_game; do not widen the contract before that evidence exists.

issues.summary: The thorner03 native bootstrap window through loop 48 exposes P2 as a Computer roster entry but has not yet reached the map-owned Tychus rescue that should materialize P2-owned or P1-visible allied units.
issues.impact: The current AI ally adapter cannot safely expose P2 commands or classify the observed owner 16 units as an ally. Static shared-vision intent and accepted native actions are insufficient while the map-owned rescue lifecycle is unreachable.
issues.nextAction: Progress the mission-owned warehouse objective through a supported gameplay path and require P2-owned units, an explicit allied observation, and an acknowledged P2 command in the same window. If that progression cannot be reproduced without debug injection or map edits, keep the map-specific P2 contract unavailable.

issues.summary: The former RO-specific API probe accepted a no-error JoinGame response without requiring status=in_game.
issues.impact: Strict response-state checks now prevent a listener or launched-only state from being reported as a playable runtime pass.
issues.nextAction: Keep strict CreateGame/JoinGame/RequestStep assertions in every future native run.
